## Scope discipline

- [ ] This change supports a manuscript claim, fills an evidence gap, fixes a
      correctness risk, satisfies a reproducibility requirement, or addresses
      a review requirement.
- [ ] The minimum sufficient implementation was chosen.
- [ ] This change does not silently alter an approved direction or claim.
- [ ] Result-driven changes are linked to a Change Request and review gate.
- [ ] Post-result exploratory analyses are labelled as exploratory.
